items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: I never had a chance to play with old man Dawson. I played a lot of my daddy's friends but I never, I don't remember playing with him.

ctx.x: Oh. Can I just, uh, see what you've got man?

Oh yeah, tell me. Did you, did you ever play with old man Dawson? No, I never had a chance to play with old man Dawson. I played a lot of my daddy's friends but I never, I don't remember playing with him. Well, when did your father die about?
